title: Agile CRM Review (2026)
intro: All-in-one CRM with a free tier (10 users) and Starter/Regular/Enterprise plans for sales, marketing, and service. This review covers pricing posture, CRM capabilities, limitations, and fit based on first-party research — not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Agile CRM overall score 6.6/10 from equal-weight CRM criteria. Free (10 users). Starter from $8.99, Regular $29.99, Enterprise $47.99 per user/mo on 2-year headline; annual $9.99/$39.99/$64.99.
verdict: Agile CRM: Choose Agile CRM when freemium entry and low Starter pricing matter more than enterprise CRM depth. Scores reflect first-party research as of 2026-08-16 — not hands-on product testing.
